rule: Per target, per control group, a diminishing ladder. Player-type ladder: full, 0.5, 0.25, then immune; taunt on flagged creatures: 1, 0.65, 0.4225, 0.274625, then 0. The level is read on the hit and moves up on the hit only when the caster is player-owned or player-charmed (world-boss casters skip the ladder entirely). The duration is capped at 10 s (or a per-family value of 6, 12, 40 or 120 s) when both sides are players. The reset comes 15 s after the last aura of the group ends. Controls are one state each (stun, confuse, fear, root) with counts; the client shows one primary state by priority stun over confuse over fear, root locks the feet only without a stun, and a control hidden under a higher one is re-resolved when the higher one ends. Stacking is a separate rule switch on spell-group rules (exclusive, exclusive from same caster, exclusive same effect, exclusive highest, default) plus per-aura-type exclusions.

look_test: Dummy target at 375 wide with one primary-state chip under its health bar. Test one: a stun, then a fear started during the stun; when the stun ends, the fear should start at once. Test two: three mob attackers chain stuns on one hero, once with the ladder counting mob hits and once without. Dom judges: does the hand-off read as the fear coming back rather than a glitch, and does the third mob stun feel shorter rather than broken. Style flag only, no release rows.
